title: AI Fantasy Map Generator
summary: Make a fantasy map with AI. Describe your world, pick a style from parchment to dungeon or hex crawl, and Flick draws it. Then walk inside it in 3D.
body_markdown:
### Can I make a fantasy map for free?


Yes, you can start free: you get 100 credits when you sign up, 200 more for joining the Flick Discord, and 100 credits every week. Every map on this page used GPT Image 2.5, which runs on the free plan, and downloads carry a Flick watermark until the Standard plan.


### Can an AI fantasy map generator write place names?


Yes, when each name is in quotation marks with a note on what it labels. Long names and very small labels are the most likely to come back misspelled, so read every one at full size.


### What is the best style for a D&D map?


For a dungeon, numbered rooms on graph paper are the easiest to run at the table. For a wilderness, a hex crawl map lets players explore one hex at a time, and a top-down battle map works for a single fight.


### Can I use an AI fantasy map in my book or game?


Check the terms of the tool you used and your publisher's rules before you print. Keep names from other books and games out of your prompt, so the map stays your own world.


### Can I edit an AI fantasy map?


Yes. Use the map as a reference and write the change you want, such as a new city or a renamed kingdom, so the rest of the map stays as it is.


### Can I animate a fantasy map?


Yes. Set the map as the start frame of an image to video clip in MiniMax H3 Fast and describe what moves, such as drifting mist or sailing ships, while the labels stay still.
